wide_sweep.note: with P28 also applied (31 = 29 clobber + 2 annul-default)

role: Port the GCC 2.95.2 call-clobber dependency analysis: keep prior argument-register sets pending as clobbers across a call instead of replacing them with the call via reg_pending_sets, and do not clear reg_last_uses.
mechanism: gcc/haifa-sched.c sched_analyze(): in the call-clobber branch drop `reg_last_uses[i] = 0`, drop the global_regs-only clobber walk, and use SET_REGNO_REG_SET (reg_pending_clobbers, i) instead of reg_pending_sets. Restores the extra REG_DEP_ANTI edges from earlier argument-register writes to the call, changing the forward dependent counts used by rank_for_schedule's depend-count heuristic; the ready-list tie for a0/a1 setups then matches SN.

evidence.note: the active scheduler is haifa-sched.c (build/gcc/Makefile SCHED_PREFIX=haifa-); gcc/sched.c is not linked as the scheduler, which is why earlier sched.c tie rules had no effect
